verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference engine and serving platform, not an agent itself, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence covers OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages and gRPC APIs plus tool-calling parsers, but nothing about an official MCP server or MCP endpoint. Tool calling at the model API level is not an MCP server, so this is an applicable capability with no supporting evidence.
